Under procedures adopted jointly by the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission and the Northwestern Indiana Regional Planning Commission, the project was judged to be of interstate significance and was, therefore, submitted to the Interstate Planning Committee for its review. At a meeting held May 22, 1974 the Interstate Planning Committee concurred with the position taken by the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission. (See Appendix C, Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission review dated May 22, 1974 including the Interstate Planning Committee review.)
